title: BRElections.jl: a Julia interface to Brazilian electoral open data (TSE)
description:
BRElections.jl gives typed access from Julia to the public electoral data published by Brazil's Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) at its open-data CDN: candidates, candidate and party votes, vote details, polling-station results, declared assets, coalitions, vacancies and voter profiles, from 1998 onward.

The package handles the mechanics that stand between the published ZIP files and a usable table: downloads with retries, exponential backoff and atomic writes; a portable local cache built on Scratch.jl; ZIP extraction with on-the-fly ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8 transcoding; chunk-based multithreaded CSV reading with column selection and row filtering applied during import, so non-matching rows never reach memory; and type conversion tuned to TSE conventions, with identifier columns kept as String so leading zeros survive.

It uses only files that are openly published, with no private API or authorisation. The data belongs to the TSE; this is an independent open-source client with no official affiliation to, or endorsement from, the TSE.
